units: cm; UE axes: +X forward, +Y right (left = -Y), +Z up
notes: Hero parts rotate rigidly around their pivots; every socket has zero rotation and unit scale.

Rest pose: pelvis pivot at pelvis_height above the floor; chain Pelvis.spine -> Torso, Torso.neck -> Head, Torso.shoulder_l/r -> UpperArm_L/R, UpperArm.elbow -> LowerArm, Pelvis.hip_l/r -> Thigh_L/R, Thigh.knee -> Shin, Shin.ankle -> Foot_L/R. Foot pivot = ankle; Foot.sole (sole centre) and Foot.toe (front tip) lie on the floor plane in rest pose (sole flat on z = 0).
LowerArm hand socket = palm surface centre; palms face the body midline in rest pose (left palm normal +Y, right palm normal -Y) so arms raised forward hold the ball between the palms.
Head eyes socket = point between the eyes (first-person camera).

Runtime-overridden slots: Team (Color), TaG (Emissive/EmissiveStrength), Glow (Emissive/EmissiveStrength), Window (EmissiveStrength; default 0 = lights off), Outline (Color: team tint of the inverted-hull outline).

All materials are unlit toon materials lit from MPC_TaG (SunDir, SunColor, ShadeColor, RimColor, Ambient, BandSharpness, BandOffset, RimStrength, RimPower; sky: SkyZenith, SkyHorizon, SkyGround). Use manual exposure (EV100 0 / exposure compensation so an unlit 1.0 shows as 1.0); dynamic shadows are not received.

M_TaGBase emissive = Color*(lerp(ShadeColor, SunColor, band)+Ambient) + rim + edge + Emissive * EmissiveStrength * VertexColor.R. Only window quads carry vertex colours (R 0.15..1.0, per-window variation); every other mesh reads 1.0.

M_TaGBase edge light (per instance) = RimColor * RimStrength * Fresnel(exponent 3, base reflect 0.04) * band (lit side only). RimStrength defaults to 0; the hero instances set 0.35 (not Outline/TaG/Glow/Jelly).
Every hero part has an Outline slot (inverted hull, M_TaGOutline, faces point inward): keep it in the same mesh component; it renders back faces only via its reversed winding.
M_TaGParticle (additive) / M_TaGParticleAlpha (translucent) read PerInstanceCustomData 0..2 = RGB, 3 = alpha: set NumCustomDataFloats = 4 on the instanced static mesh component.
SM_SkyDome (radius 160000 cm, centre (550, 0, 0)) and SM_Clouds are authored in court coordinates: spawn at identity, no collision, cast shadows off.
Rim: torus with tube centre-line radius RimRadius (22.5) and tube radius RimTube (1.0), exactly the torus TaGBallSim collides against; inner edge radius is therefore 21.5.
Court/city meshes are authored in court coordinates: spawn them at the identity transform, except SM_Net.

SM_Net (the net, slot Net, MI_Net_Net) has its pivot at the rim centre: spawn it at (RimX, 0, RimZ) = (157.5, 0, 305) and scale / wobble it around that point; socket net_bottom is 40 cm below the pivot.
Collision: SM_Rooftop has one simple box (x -600..1700, y -1300..1300, z -100..0); SM_Hoop has simple boxes for the pole and padding only; all other meshes have no simple collision.

ui.icon_note: white glyph on transparent (tint it in Slate); UserInterface2D, UI group, no mips
